gauge.name: Gila River at Painted Rock Lake

impacts.statement: Water reaches the reservoir embankment crest elevation. Crest length is 4780 feet.
Water reaches the reservoir spillway crest elevation. Spillway length is 610 feet.
Flood releases begin through outlet gates.

dataAttribution.title: Observations courtesy of U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
